name: Syracuse random variables on 3-adic rings
description: A construction of explicit random variables ∑ᵢ 3^{i-1} 2^{-(a₁+…+aᵢ)} mod 3ⁿ from i.i.d. geometric exponents that model the value of the accelerated Collatz (Syracuse) map on the cyclic group ℤ/3ⁿℤ.

name: Characteristic function decay estimate for Syracuse distributions
description: The characteristic function 𝔼 e^{-2πiξ·Syrac/3ⁿ} of the Syracuse random variable on ℤ/3ⁿℤ decays faster than any fixed negative power of n at every nonzero non-3-divisible frequency ξ.

name: Approximate transport of logarithmic density under Collatz first-passage map
function_signature: (log-density measure on ℕ, Collatz first-passage time) -> (approximately invariant pushforward measure)
description: A method showing that the logarithmic-density distribution of n is approximately preserved under the Collatz first-passage random variable, reducing the bounded-orbit problem to mixing of the associated 3-adic random walk.

name: Almost-bounded Collatz orbits theorem
description: For any function f tending to infinity, the minimal value Col_min(N) attained by the Collatz orbit of N is below f(N) for almost all N in the sense of logarithmic density.

name: Collatz conjecture
description: The conjecture that iterating the Collatz map (n↦n/2 if even, 3n+1 if odd) from any positive integer eventually reaches 1.

name: Collatz map
description: The function on positive integers sending even n to n/2 and odd n to 3n+1.

name: Sendov's conjecture
description: The conjecture that for a complex polynomial of degree at least 2 with all zeros in the closed unit disk, every zero has a critical point of the polynomial within distance one.

name: Sendov's conjecture for high-degree polynomials
description: There is an absolute degree threshold n₀ above which Sendov's conjecture holds for all polynomials of degree n, proved by a probabilistic compactness argument on empirical zero measures.

name: Probabilistic reformulation of polynomial zeros as point processes
function_signature: (polynomial f of degree n) -> (random zero λ and random critical point ζ uniform on zero sets)
description: A method recasting statements about all zeros and critical points of a polynomial as statements about random variables drawn uniformly from the multiplicity-counted zero sets of the polynomial and its derivative.

name: Logarithmic potential and Stieltjes transform of empirical zero measure
function_signature: (empirical zero measure μ) -> (logarithmic potential Uμ and Stieltjes transform sμ = f'/(nf))
description: The representation of the normalized logarithmic derivative f'/(nf) of a polynomial as the Stieltjes transform of its empirical zero measure, with the associated logarithmic potential controlling zero locations via potential theory.

name: Compactness limiting argument for high-degree polynomials
function_signature: (sequence of degree-n counterexamples, n→∞) -> (limiting random variables) -> contradiction
description: A strategy extracting weak limits via Prokhorov tightness of the random zero and critical-point variables of a hypothetical sequence of high-degree counterexamples and deriving a contradiction from the limiting potential-theoretic structure.

name: Grace's apolarity theorem
description: A classical apolarity criterion stating that the zeros of two apolar polynomials of the same degree cannot be separated by any circle (or more generally any circular region).

name: Local Fourier uniformity conjecture for multiplicative functions
description: The conjecture that bounded multiplicative functions such as the Liouville function have negligible averaged Gowers Uᵏ uniformity norm over almost all short intervals.

name: Higher-order local Fourier uniformity of multiplicative functions
description: The Liouville and Möbius functions have asymptotically vanishing averaged Gowers Uᵏ norm over short intervals of length H≥exp(log^{5/8+ε}X) for every fixed k, extending the previously known linear case.

name: Matomäki–Radziwiłł method
function_signature: (mean of multiplicative function over short interval) -> (mean over long interval via small-prime factorization)
description: A technique controlling averages of bounded multiplicative functions in short intervals by exploiting their factorization through small prime factors to relate short-interval to long-interval averages.

name: Multiplicativity at small primes functional equation
description: A method using the identity λ(pn)=−λ(n) at small primes to force any nilsequence correlating with the Liouville function to be approximately dilation-invariant, which is then ruled out by Lie-theoretic rigidity on the nilmanifold.

name: Chowla conjecture
description: The conjecture that shifted products ∑_{n≤X} λ(n+h₁)…λ(n+hₖ) of the Liouville (or Möbius) function over distinct shifts exhibit cancellation, i.e. are o(X).

name: Infinite partial sumsets in the primes
description: There exist two infinite increasing sequences (aᵢ) and (bⱼ) of natural numbers whose pairwise sums aᵢ+bⱼ for i<j are all prime, resolving an Erdős question on partial sumsets in the primes.

name: Bergelson intersectivity lemma
function_signature: (countable family of positive-measure sets) -> (infinite subfamily with all finite intersections of positive measure)
description: A measure-theoretic selection principle extracting from infinitely many positive-measure sets an infinite subfamily whose every finite intersection still has positive measure.

name: Maynard sieve for prime-producing tuples
function_signature: (admissible k-tuple of shifts) -> (positive proportion of n giving ≥m primes among n+hᵢ)
description: A multidimensional Selberg-type sieve with smooth weights that, for any admissible tuple of shifts, produces a positive density of n for which many of the shifted values n+hᵢ are simultaneously prime.

name: Kra–Moreira–Richter–Robertson sumset theorem
description: Every set of positive upper density in the natural numbers contains a B+B-type infinite sumset configuration, resolving Erdős's sumset conjecture via topological dynamics.

name: Polymath8 distribution estimate
description: A Bombieri–Vinogradov-type equidistribution of primes in arithmetic progressions to smooth moduli at a level of distribution exceeding 1/2, obtained via Weil/Deligne exponential sum bounds, used to drive the H₁≤246 prime gap bound.

name: de Bruijn–Newman constant nonnegativity
description: The de Bruijn–Newman constant Λ, defined so that the heat-deformed Riemann ξ-function H_t has only real zeros iff t≥Λ, satisfies Λ≥0, so the Riemann hypothesis (Λ≤0) would be only barely true.

name: Backward heat flow repulsion of zeros
function_signature: (real zeros of H_t under reverse heat flow) -> (contradiction unless zeros are too regularly spaced)
description: A method tracking the dynamics of zeros of the heat-deformed ξ-function under reverse time, showing that Λ<0 would force the zeros to be implausibly regularly spaced, contradicting known pair-correlation behavior.

name: Erdős primitive set conjecture
description: The conjecture that among all primitive sets (sets with no element dividing another) the sum ∑_{a∈A} 1/(a log a) is maximized by the set of primes.

name: Lichtman bound for primitive sets
description: For every primitive set A the reciprocal log-weighted sum ∑_{a∈A} 1/(a log a) is at most the corresponding sum ∑_p 1/(p log p) over the primes, resolving the Erdős primitive set conjecture.

name: de Grey chromatic number of the plane lower bound
description: The chromatic number of the unit-distance graph of the Euclidean plane is at least five, established via an explicit non-4-colorable finite unit-distance graph.

name: Hadwiger–Nelson problem
description: The open problem of determining the minimum number of colors needed to color the plane so that no two points at unit distance share a color.

name: Bourgain–Clozel–Kahane Fourier uncertainty principle
description: A real even self-dual function (f=f̂) that is nonpositive at the origin in both physical and frequency space cannot change sign arbitrarily close to the origin, quantifying a +1-eigenfunction sign uncertainty linked to sphere packing linear programming bounds.

name: Polymath project (massively collaborative mathematics)
function_signature: (hard open problem) -> (open online collaborative incremental progress) -> (verified result or simplification)
description: A methodology of solving or simplifying mathematical problems through open, public, incremental online collaboration by many contributors.

name: Entropic doubling constant
description: The Shannon-entropy analogue of the combinatorial doubling constant, defined for a group-valued random variable X as d(X;X)=H(X₁+X₂)−H(X) using two independent copies.

name: Entropic Ruzsa distance
description: A symmetric, nonnegative, triangle-inequality-obeying pseudo-distance d(X;Y)=H(X'−Y')−H(X)/2−H(Y)/2 between two independent group-valued random variables, the entropy analogue of Ruzsa distance.

name: Entropy method for additive combinatorics
function_signature: (combinatorial sumset problem) -> (inequality among Shannon entropies of group-valued random variables)
description: A proof strategy replacing sets and their sumsets with group-valued random variables and analyzing combinatorial doubling via Shannon entropy quantities, working entirely in physical space rather than Fourier space.

name: Fibring inequality (entropic)
description: An entropy inequality stating that the entropic doubling of X is at least the doubling of its homomorphic image π(X) plus the conditional doubling along the fibers, enabling decomposition of the doubling problem.

name: Conditional doubling constant
description: The entropic doubling constant of a random variable measured conditionally on the value of a homomorphic image, quantifying doubling within the fibers of a homomorphism.

name: Entropic Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers lemma
description: An entropy-formulated analogue of the Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers theorem converting small conditional mutual information into structural control with bounded entropic doubling, used in the PFR endgame.

name: Sumset/intersection improvement operations
function_signature: (random variable X with doubling K) -> (random variable X' with strictly smaller entropic doubling)
description: A pair of operations replacing A by A+A or by A∩(A+h) for typical h, each of which strictly reduces the entropic doubling constant unless a rigid conditional-independence configuration is reached.

name: Induction on the doubling constant
function_signature: (claim at doubling K) -> (reduction to claim at smaller doubling, down to base case)
description: A descent strategy that inductively lowers the entropic doubling constant by repeatedly applying improvement operations until reaching the trivial regime where the sumset is already a subspace.

name: Characteristic-2 endgame identity
description: The use of the characteristic-2 cancellation identity (X₁+X₂)+(X₂+X₃)=X₁+X₃ together with conditional independence relative to X₁+X₂+X₃+X₄ to close the PFR argument.

name: Rao sunflower bound via Shannon coding
description: A refinement of the Alweiss–Lovett–Wu–Zhang sunflower bound giving Sun(k,r) ≤ O(r log k)^k, obtained by encoding spread sets through the Shannon noiseless coding theorem.

name: Entropy proof of the sunflower lemma
function_signature: (spread set family) -> (sunflower, via conditional entropy bounds)
description: Tao's information-theoretic reformulation proving the improved sunflower lemma by bounding conditional Shannon entropy of constrained random variables instead of using explicit encoding schemes.

name: Inverse theorem entropy
description: The minimal cardinality of a family of structured functions needed so that every 1-bounded function with seminorm at least η correlates at level ε with some family member, quantifying the complexity of an inverse theorem.

name: Random sampling argument for inverse-theorem entropy bounds
function_signature: (seminorm with an inverse theorem) -> (dimension-independent entropy bound)
description: A technique conditioning on a randomly chosen subset with tuned probability to construct dual functions with controllable L² bounds, yielding inverse-theorem-entropy bounds independent of dimension in certain regimes.

name: Inverse theorem for the U³ Gowers norm on arbitrary finite abelian groups
description: A bounded function on an arbitrary finite abelian group with large U³ norm correlates with a Lipschitz function on an explicit degree-two filtered nilmanifold composed with a polynomial map.

name: Manners' nilsequence encoding of locally quadratic phases
description: An algebraic construction encoding a locally quadratic phase function as a nilsequence on a degree-two filtered nilmanifold, adapted to arbitrary finite abelian groups.

name: Blueprint-driven formalization
function_signature: (informal proof) -> (human-readable blueprint with dependency graph linked to Lean4 formalization)
description: A formalization methodology using Massot's Blueprint tool to write a human-readable proof outline whose statements link to Lean4 lemmas, with a color-coded dependency graph tracking formalization progress.

name: Lean4 formalization of PFR
description: A complete machine-verified proof in the Lean4 proof assistant of the Gowers–Green–Manners–Tao proof of the polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture over 𝔽₂ⁿ.
